description: This file defines a PHP class PerformanceTrackReviewerModel, which models the data for a performance tracker reviewer within the OrangeHRM system. It uses traits and interfaces for serialization and normalization, and sets up attribute filtering for handling reviewer data.

classes.name: PerformanceTrackReviewerModel
classes.description: A model class representing a performance track reviewer, including attributes such as employee number, name, employee ID, and termination ID, facilitating API serialization and normalization.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializes the model with an entity, and sets filters and attribute names for serialization.
